whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Galangal Grill,

I noticed your fine dining restaurant has a prime location at Hotel Gargee Grand near Gandhi Maidan, Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated direct booking and mobile menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital menu, aur review highlights integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/galangalgrill

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Galangal Grill, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Galangal Grill at Hotel Gargee Grand, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a mobile-friendly digital menu, table reservation WhatsApp triggers, and showcasing your fine dining ambiance near Gandhi Maidan. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
